title: MACP mode conformance fixture
description: A scripted session transcript with per-message accept/reject expectations, runnable against any MACP runtime.

participants.description: Declared participant roster. MAY be empty: RFC-MACP-0012 Section 4.1 states that MACP does not require SessionStart to declare a non-empty participants list, and macp-envelope.schema.json sets no minItems on the field. See decision_zero_participants.json.

accepted_at_ms.description: Optional acceptance clock for this step, in milliseconds on the session timeline: the runtime's recorded acceptance time of RFC-MACP-0001 Section 7.6 item 4, which the harness supplies to the runtime. It is distinct from the Envelope's timestamp_unix_ms (see 'envelope'). All-or-none: when any message carries it, every message MUST, and the values MUST be non-decreasing. The harness then accepts the fixture's own SessionStart at acceptance time 0 with Envelope timestamp_unix_ms 0. When no message carries it, the harness uses its own clock.

envelope.description: Optional overrides for Envelope fields the harness otherwise derives: session_id (default: the id the harness minted for the fixture's session), macp_version (default: '1.0'), mode (default: the fixture's mode) and timestamp_unix_ms (default: the harness clock, or 0 when accepted_at_ms is in use). A message whose message_type is SessionStart MUST set session_id, because it opens a session other than the fixture's own.

^_.description: Non-normative annotation (e.g. _comment). Harnesses MUST ignore keys starting with '_'.

expected_history.description: Optional exact assertion on the fixture session's accepted history after its SessionStart, in acceptance order and with no extra entries. It includes runtime-emitted envelopes that no message submitted, such as the synthetic HandoffAccept of RFC-MACP-0010 Section 5.1; mark those with synthetic: true. 'payload' is a subset match on the decoded payload.

synthetic.description: true for a runtime-emitted envelope that no message in the transcript submitted.

^_.description: Non-normative annotation (e.g. _comment). Harnesses MUST ignore keys starting with '_'.

policy.description: Optional inline PolicyDefinition registered before SessionStart

^_.description: Non-normative annotation (e.g. _comment). Harnesses MUST ignore keys starting with '_'.
